Round-1 finding 1 is addressed: _parse_yyyy_mm_dd now requires the exact YYYY-MM-DD shape, so alternate ISO forms are rejected.

bug — src/market_update/metrics.py:215-216: active_reductions still reports missing_column instead of status_absent when the export contains no Active rows and Previous List Price is also absent. The DESIGN.md not-in-export contract requires status_absent for Active-derived metrics when Active is absent. A focused in-memory probe with one Closed listing and both optional price columns missing reproduced availability="missing_column". The existing closed-only test includes Previous List Price, so it does not exercise this precedence case. Smallest fix: check _has_status(export, "Active") before the missing-column branch and return a status_absent metric when false.
